turns.response_html: Making jam is a fun project! You'll need about 2 and a half pounds of Concord grapes, 3 cups of sugar, and the juice of one lemon. First, remove the grapes from their stems and wash them. Next, put the grapes and lemon juice in a big pot and simmer them for about 10 minutes until the grapes are soft and juicy. Then, push the grapes through a sieve to get rid of the skins and seeds. Put the grape pulp back in the pot, add the sugar, and cook it over medium heat. Keep stirring until the sugar dissolves and the jam gets thick. This usually takes about 15-20 minutes. To check if it's ready, put a spoonful on a cold plate and see if it sets. Once it's ready, let it cool a bit, then pour it into clean jars and seal them. Do you have all the ingredients you need?
